visibility(duration) sets how long a received message stays hidden; the crate re-arms it halfway through each timeout while the handler runs. The visibility timeout is what each receive asks for: how long a received message stays hidden from every other receive. SQS counts the timeout in whole seconds, from one second to twelve hours. A value outside that range stops the service at startup with SqsError::InvalidQueue. A fraction above one second rounds up to the next whole second, so a message never comes back sooner than the timeout asked for. A subscription that names none takes the queue's own timeout, which it reads once with GetQueueAttributes when it opens, so it needs the sqs:GetQueueAttributes permission. A handler may take longer than the timeout. While a handler holds a delivery, the crate re-arms the timeout halfway through each period with ChangeMessageVisibility, so no other consumer receives the message in the meantime. The other half of the period is left for the call to reach the queue, so a one-second timeout is re-armed every half second. SQS keeps a message hidden for at most twelve hours from its receive, and an extension does not restart them. A handler that holds a delivery that long gets one last extension to the end of the twelve hours and a warning in the log; after that the queue hands the message to another consumer. The timeout also decides how soon an abandoned delivery comes back: a message dropped unsettled, or one a stopped process held, is received again once the timeout lapses. In process, a subscription that names no timeout gets the 30 seconds of a new queue; the timeout an operator set on a queue shows only in a live test. The step is on SqsQueue, and on the mount chain through SqsSubscription::visibility, as in the example.

A report takes five seconds to render, and a receive hides it for two; the report is still handled once. The crate /// re-arms the visibility every second while the handler runs, so no other consumer gets the /// report in the meantime. #[subscriber(SqsQueue)] async fn publish_report(report: &Report) -> HandlerOutcome { render(report).await; tracing::info!(report.id, "report published"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn service(broker: SqsBroker, queue: String) -> impl App<State = ()> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("reports", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( publish_report .name(queue) .visibility(Duration::from_secs(2)), ); }) } examples/manual/sqs_subscriptions_visibility.rs /// Rendering a report takes longer than the two seconds a receive hides it for. The crate /// re-arms the visibility every second while the handler runs, so no other consumer gets the /// report in the meantime. struct PublishReport; impl Handle<Report> for PublishReport { async fn handle( &self, report: &Report, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { render(report).await; tracing::info!(report.id, "report published"); Ok(()) } } fn service(broker: SqsBroker, queue: String) -> impl App<State = ()> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("reports", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( subscriber(Unnamed::<SqsQueue>::new(), PublishReport) .build() .name(queue) .visibility(Duration::from_secs(2)), ); }) }

wait(duration) sets how long one receive waits for a message, 20 seconds by default and at most; a longer wait stops the service at startup. The wait is the WaitTimeSeconds of each ReceiveMessage: the long poll. A receive returns as soon as a message arrives, and returns empty when the wait runs out. An empty receive hands the handler nothing. A longer wait means fewer empty receives, and SQS bills per request. The default is the SQS maximum of 20 seconds, so a subscription that names no wait already polls as long as SQS allows. A wait over 20 seconds stops the service at startup with SqsError::InvalidQueue. A zero wait is short polling: each receive returns at once, with what a sample of the queue's servers holds. TestApp::start connects SqsBroker to an in-process account with queues, visibility, receive counts, redrive, FIFO groups and topics. A test hands the harness the app main runs, unchanged, and addresses the broker by its production type, tb.broker::<SqsBroker>(). The testing feature in [dev-dependencies] adds the in-process mode, and turns on the core's harness with it. The account has no settings of its own. Its queue URLs are built on the broker's endpoint and region, and every setting a queue has comes from the service's descriptors. Every queue and topic the service names exists in it. The account keeps SQS's semantics. A queue hands each message to one of its subscriptions, and one receive returns at most ten messages. A received message stays invisible until it is deleted or its visibility timeout lapses; a descriptor that names no visibility gets the 30 seconds of a new queue. The receive count rises with every receive, and a redrive policy moves a message whose receives ran out to the dead-letter queue. A FIFO group waits while one of its messages is in flight, and a deduplication id is remembered for five minutes. With sns, a topic delivers a copy to every queue subscribed to it. The account refuses what SQS and SNS refuse: more than ten headers, a header name the service does not take, an empty body or header value, a message over the size limit, a queue name over 80 characters, a dead-letter queue of the other kind, a maxReceiveCount over 1000, a visibility that would end more than twelve hours after the receive, and a FIFO queue on a standard topic. A publish through the harness that SQS would refuse fails the test. A standard queue keeps the order of its messages here, which SQS does not promise. A message sent to a queue no subscription reads is dropped. A publish through the harness returns once every handler it woke has settled. tb.advance(..), on a clock paused with #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)], moves past a visibility timeout or a deferred retry. What belongs to a running service, such as a queue an operator configured, is for a live test.

TestApp::start_live runs the same test body against LocalStack or AWS, for what belongs to the service: queues, timeouts, credentials. It connects the broker through its ordinary connect, so every subscription resolves its queue on the stack and every request is signed. The body is the one an in-process test runs; only the start call differs. A publish, settle and advance wait on the real clock until every subscription has handled what was published to it. The wait lasts ten seconds at most, and start_live_within sets another bound. The live mode is for what the in-process account leaves to the service: a message kept on a queue no subscription reads, the visibility timeout an operator set on a queue, the queues and topics the service expects to find without creating them, and credentials. A stack keeps what earlier runs left in it, so each run names its queues uniquely, and creates them with create_if_missing or before the app starts. In the example, live::endpoint returns the stack's address from SQS_TEST_ENDPOINT, and the test returns early without one, so cargo test passes on a machine with no stack. A job that stood a stack up sets RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE=1, and a missing address then fails the test instead of skipping it. The repository's stand is LocalStack in docker-compose.test.yml, which just brokers-up starts.

本指南把一条消息向一个 SNS 主题发布一次，让 SNS 把一份副本投递给订阅该主题的每个 SQS 队列。 SNS 到 SQS 是 AWS 服务做扇出的方式：一个主题，每个消费者一个队列。 本 crate 向主题发布；主题背后的每个队列按普通方式读取。 向 SNS 发布需要 sns feature： Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream-sqs-sns = { version = "0.7", features = ["sns"] } 示例是一个商店。 它接受订单并在一个主题上发布通知，计费和发货各自从自己的队列读取这条通知。

基于 aws-sdk-sqs 的服务要自己编写接收循环。 下表列出每一部分在 RustStream 中的位置： aws-sdk-sqs RustStream aws_config::load_from_env 和 Client::new SqsBroker::new，或者 SqsBroker::from_config 加上你自己的 SdkConfig（在生产环境中运行） get_queue_url SqsQueue::new 中的队列名称，启动时解析一次 一个 receive_message().wait_time_seconds(20) 循环 一个 #[subscriber] 处理器（消费队列） 反序列化 message.body() 处理器的参数类型，由编解码器解码 处理完成后调用 delete_message 处理器的结果 HandlerOutcome::ack（确认与投递保证） change_message_visibility HandlerOutcome::retry_after（重试与死信队列） 在控制台中设置的 RedrivePolicy 挂载处的 max_attempts 和 dead_letter send_message 回复或 Out 参数，经由 SqsPublish 发送 message_group_id 和 message_deduplication_id SqsPublishSteps 的发布步骤 group_id 和 deduplication_id（FIFO 队列）
本指南在 AWS 上运行一个 SQS 服务：它的凭证和区域从哪里来，它使用的超时，以及它所需的 IAM 权限。

SqsBroker::new() 不从代码中获取任何东西。 服务启动时，AWS SDK 的默认链查找区域和凭证：环境变量、共享的 ~/.aws 文件、SSO，以及容器或实例的角色。 在 ECS、EKS、Lambda 或 EC2 上以 IAM 角色运行的服务完全不需要配置。 SDK 在签名第一个请求时读取凭证。 这个请求就是第一个订阅在启动时发出的 GetQueueUrl，所以凭证错误的服务会在处理任何消息之前停止。

It names its // visibility, so the subscription does not read the queue's own. #[subscriber(SqsQueue::new("orders").visibility(Duration::from_secs(120)))] async fn take_order(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker( SqsBroker::from_config(aws_config()), |b| { b.include(take_order); }, ) } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Order { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Order { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "orders"; } impl MessageHeaders for Order { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Order { const NAME: &'static str = "Order"; } struct TakeOrder; impl Handle<Order> for TakeOrder { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker( SqsBroker::from_config(aws_config()), |b| { // The queue belongs to the infrastructure, so the descriptor does not create it. It // names its visibility, so the subscription does not read the queue's own. b.include( subscriber("orders", TakeOrder) .map_source(|_| SqsQueue::new("orders").visibility(Duration::from_secs(120))) .build(), ); }, ) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } orders 队列属于基础设施：由 Terraform、CloudFormation 或控制台创建，连同它的重新驱动策略和加密设置。 描述符不用 create_if_missing，所以缺失的队列会让服务在启动时停止，而不是创建一个空队列。 描述符指定了可见性，所以订阅不读取队列自己的超时。 endpoint 和 region 让 Broker 指向另一个端点、VPC 端点或本地环境。 对于用 from_config 构建的 Broker，它们会取代配置自身的 endpoint_url 和 region。 SQS 返回的队列 URL 会被改写到该端点上。

SqsBroker::new() 给每个 SQS 请求每次尝试 25 秒，高于长轮询最多等待的 20 秒。 你自己的配置用 timeout_config 设置它，示例就是这样做的；低于 20 秒的尝试超时会让每次长轮询都中途结束。 SDK 按自己的重试策略重试失败的请求。 请求通过 SDK 默认的 HTTPS 客户端发送。 专用线程上的处理器（threads(n)）通过自己的 SDK 客户端发送，这些客户端由同一份配置构建，共用它的凭证。

上面的服务需要在它的队列上拥有这些权限： policy.json { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "sqs:GetQueueUrl", "sqs:ReceiveMessage", "sqs:DeleteMessage", "sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility" ], "Resource": "arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:123456789012:orders" } ] } 每项功能都会增加自己的权限： 功能 权限 没有指定可见性的订阅 队列上的 sqs:GetQueueAttributes max_attempts 和 dead_letter 队列上的 sqs:SetQueueAttributes，死信队列上的 sqs:GetQueueAttributes create_if_missing sqs:CreateQueue 向队列发布 队列上的 sqs:GetQueueUrl 和 sqs:SendMessage 向主题发布 主题上的 sns:CreateTopic 和 sns:Publish subscribe_queue_to_topic 主题上的 sns:CreateTopic 和 sns:Subscribe，队列上的 sqs:GetQueueUrl、sqs:GetQueueAttributes 和 sqs:SetQueueAttributes
启用 asyncapi feature 时，服务的 AsyncAPI 文档指定一个服务器：Broker 端点所在的主机；没有端点时，是其区域的区域主机，例如 sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com。 文档从不包含凭证或队列的 ARN，因此可以公开发布。 示例文件中的测试在进程内启动同一个应用；进程内 SQS 从配置中获取区域，不签名任何东西。 测试 SQS 服务介绍测试工具。
本指南立即或稍后重试 SQS 消息，限制它的投递次数，并让 SQS 把反复失败的消息移入死信队列。 这两件事都由 SQS 自己完成。 重试就是让同一条消息再次可见，它的接收计数保持不变。 次数上限和死信队列构成队列的重新驱动策略，由挂载处声明。 示例是一个发票服务，它向客户收取发票款项。

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "invoices")] struct Invoice { id: u64, customer: String, amount_cents: u64, } #[subscriber(SqsQueue::new("invoices").create_if_missing())] async fn charge(invoice: &Invoice) -> HandlerOutcome { if invoice.customer.is_empty() { // Another try gets the same answer. tracing::warn!(invoice.id, "invoice without a customer dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } if invoice.amount_cents > CREDIT_LIMIT_CENTS { tracing::info!(invoice.id, "invoice waits for the credit check"); return HandlerOutcome::retry_after(CREDIT_CHECK); } tracing::info!(invoice.id, invoice.amount_cents, "invoice charged"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// The largest invoice charged without a credit check. const CREDIT_LIMIT_CENTS: u64 = 100_000; /// How long an invoice waits for the credit check before it comes back. const CREDIT_CHECK: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30); #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Invoice { id: u64, customer: String, amount_cents: u64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Invoice { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "invoices"; } impl MessageHeaders for Invoice { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Invoice { const NAME: &'static str = "Invoice"; } struct Charge; impl Handle<Invoice> for Charge { fn handle( &self, invoice: &Invoice, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { if invoice.customer.is_empty() { // Another try gets the same answer. tracing::warn!(invoice.id, "invoice without a customer dropped"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } if invoice.amount_cents > CREDIT_LIMIT_CENTS { tracing::info!(invoice.id, "invoice waits for the credit check"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(CREDIT_CHECK))); } tracing::info!(invoice.id, invoice.amount_cents, "invoice charged"); ready(Ok(())) } } 超出信用额度的发票要等待信用检查。 retry_after 把消息的可见性超时设为 30 秒，这段时间结束时，SQS 再次交出它。 SQS 按整秒计数，所以不足一秒的部分向上取整。 SQS 从接收起最多隐藏消息十二小时，所以延迟在这十二小时内结束。 更长的延迟会缩短到这十二小时结束为止，本 crate 同时记录一条注明队列名称的警告日志。 消息始终留在它的队列中，所以延迟的重试在服务重启后依然有效。 retry 把可见性设为零，消息立即再次交出。 没有客户的发票每次尝试都得到同样的答案，所以 charge 丢弃它。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_back_ordered_order_comes_back_after_the_restock() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(service(SqsBroker::new())).await?; let waiting = order(3, 2_500, true); tb.broker::<SqsBroker>().message(&waiting).publish().await?; tb.advance(RESTOCK).await?; tb.broker::<SqsBroker>() .subscriber("checkout-orders") .assert_called(2) .with(&waiting) .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(RESTOCK)); // The same message came back; nothing was published again to bring it. tb.broker::<SqsBroker>() .published::<Order>("checkout-orders") .assert_called_once(); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } src/main.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_back_ordered_order_comes_back_after_the_restock() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(service(SqsBroker::new())).await?; let waiting = order(3, 2_500, true); tb.broker::<SqsBroker>().message(&waiting).publish().await?; tb.advance(RESTOCK).await?; tb.broker::<SqsBroker>() .subscriber("checkout-orders") .assert_called(2) .with(&waiting) .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(RESTOCK)); // The same message came back; nothing was published again to bring it. tb.broker::<SqsBroker>() .published::<Order>("checkout-orders") .assert_called_once(); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } 测试在暂停的时钟上启动，advance 让时钟前进。 一小时的 RESTOCK 不花任何时间。 retry_after 让消息在延迟期间不可见，与 SQS 相同，时钟越过延迟时，队列再次交出它。 published 显示 checkout-orders 上只有一个订单：第二次投递是同一条消息，而不是副本。

进程内 SQS 是测试内部的一个账户，服务指定的每个队列和主题都存在于其中。 它模拟服务逻辑所依赖的行为： 队列把每条消息交给它的一个订阅，收到的消息保持不可见，直到被删除或它的可见性超时结束。 接收计数随每次接收增长，重新驱动策略把用尽接收次数的消息移入死信队列。 一批最多包含一次接收返回的十条消息。 FIFO 组在它的某条消息处于传输中时等待，重复数据删除 id 会被记住五分钟。 启用 sns 时，主题把一份副本投递给用 subscribe_queue_to_topic 订阅的每个队列。 SQS 或 SNS 拒绝的东西，在这里也会被拒绝：超过十个消息头、SQS 不接受的消息头名称、空的正文或消息头值、超过大小上限的消息、超过 80 个字符的队列名称、类型不同的死信队列、超过 1000 的 maxReceiveCount、结束时间晚于接收后十二小时的可见性，以及订阅标准主题的 FIFO 队列。 标准队列在这里保持消息的顺序，而 SQS 并不保证这一点。 没有指定可见性的描述符得到 30 秒，即新队列的默认值。 发送到无人订阅的队列的消息会被丢弃。 运维人员在队列上设置的可见性、服务期望找到的队列和主题，以及凭证，要在正在运行的环境上检验。
